goal: One actual bounded Codex implementation in a new Host-owned candidate directory, followed by an explicit fixed check policy, same-byte baseline/candidate/diff/check seals and a usable bounded diff result. Preserve the user's original dirty tree. Remain on the existing Coordinator/Task/Run/lease/events/store; do not implement acceptance/application or automatic repair.

minimum_supported_case.project: An explicitly selected bounded source roster; first registered real acceptance uses a fresh small public Go fixture and an exact reviewed offline check policy.
minimum_supported_case.scope_limit: This first slice is not arbitrary repository cloning, arbitrary commands, arbitrary project test execution, or proof that all Windows programs are confined. Grow supported policies only after their actual enforcement evidence.

current_source_facts.fact: Current public/production contract accepts only codex/workspace-read and a fixed readonly profile. Native admission is separate from Mu qualification.

current_source_facts.lines: Submit; runHarness; recoverArtifact calls; harnessUnknown; finishHarness
current_source_facts.fact: Sealed input MANIFEST, single existing Scan claim, actual Host principal/workspace gates, before-resume native identity, heartbeat/cancel, atomic UNKNOWN terminal projection, same-Run result upload/ArtifactUse and durable observation already exist.
Reusable handle-bound authorized original-tree reads, reparse checks and bounded bytes. Original workspace remains a read source.

Reuse safe metadata/temporary-copy diff primitives. Do not call WorkspaceDiff as the candidate diff: its HEAD/INDEX baseline would mix the user's preexisting dirty changes. Its conventional .git requirement also does not support linked worktrees.
The manual workspace write path refuses a RUNNING task and writes the registered original workspace. It is not a candidate-Harness write port.
This helper seals with run_id nil. It cannot replace run-bound candidate evidence.
Use binds original Run/epoch/principal/upload/content/input/context and receipt; keep its constraints.

Existing authenticated artifact-content path checks visibility/current body, sealed bytes/hash/size and attachment/security headers. Reuse this for full diff/check content instead of a second blob server.

Currently requests source read only, with a real owned marker, fixed no-shell argv, Job identity and complete waiting/drain. Add an explicit private typed candidate branch without changing ordinary readonly arguments.
Reuse existing owned process primitives. A Job is cleanup evidence, not a filesystem sandbox.

implementation_flow: Root freezes the opt-in wire contract and registers exact source lease. Client submits original authorized_workspace_ref, stable request_id, prompt, explicit bounded source/edit roster, expected baseline digest if already previewed, and one Host-known check_policy_ref. Reject physical paths, executable/argv/env/TOML, provider credentials, trusted booleans and unknown fields.

Submit seals normalized intent through the existing idempotency and Task input MANIFEST and returns QUEUED/run null. Lost ACK is lookup of the original ID only. No copy or model dispatch before the existing Scan/claim/lease/gates.

After claim, revalidate current actual Host Owner and WorkspaceAuthority. Host derives a fresh private data-root directory from the original Run/epoch/dispatch locator; the source and candidate trees must be disjoint. No request chooses the candidate path or constructs the typed authority object.

Host snapshots only the explicit source roster through the original root handle, not a recursive clone. Include current authorized dirty bytes as the actual baseline; record HEAD/index/dirty metadata separately. Do not copy .git, .codex, credentials, local environment files, ignored configuration, links or implicit extra content.

Reject noncanonical Windows paths, case aliases, duplicate roster entries, hardlinks, reparse points/junctions, special files, unexpected inventory, bounds overflow and copy-time identity/content drift. Keep a sealed baseline copy outside model-writable candidate space. Pin fixed public check/config bytes separately from editable source.

BeforeResume rechecks original authority plus exact candidate/baseline/fixed inventory and identity. Supply a Host-only typed candidate permission plan. Native argv uses the current custom default_permissions model with source readonly and only the exact owned candidate scope writable; no --sandbox combination or dangerous bypass. Requested permissions remain distinct from actual qualification.

Dispatch one Codex turn in the candidate tree. The model cannot supply source bytes as final authority, select checks, choose process arguments, alter the sealed baseline or mark its own checks passed. Keep ordinary workspace-read path byte-for-byte compatible for absent candidate context.

Keep the existing lease/heartbeat and cancel gate through the complete native/check pipeline. Wait for actual native process stop, empty Job and drained streams before inspecting final candidate. Cancellation/revocation/UNKNOWN must not start subsequent checks or a second model turn.

Host freezes the post-native candidate inventory and content. Reject edits outside the allowed paths and changed fixed check/config bytes. Generate diff from sealed baseline bytes to these exact candidate bytes, not HEAD to candidate.

Run only the exact Host-known check policy against this frozen candidate, with pinned executable/toolchain and argv, isolated owned caches/output directories, offline settings, bounded time/output, no shell and original-tree write denial. Record each check invocation/command digest and actual PID/creation-time/Job facts under the original Run/epoch before allowing it to execute; do not overwrite the native model process identity. Capture real stdout/stderr/exit/cancel/Job/drain. After checks rehash candidate/fixed inputs; any mutation invalidates that check/candidate association.

Before terminal projection, seal baseline/candidate inventory, diff and complete check evidence via existing recoverArtifact/ArtifactUse under the original Run/epoch. Bind Root source/policy/toolchain, original input MANIFEST, native identity/thread, baseline/candidate/fixed suite hashes and actual check results. Preserve one authoritative Harness result membership and make it reference the auxiliary seals; do not add arbitrary auxiliary REPORTs as independent model outputs.

Publish the candidate projection and existing terminal event atomically with the terminal state. Native completion, check success and business acceptance remain separate facts. Failed checks retain the candidate and raw evidence as CHECK_FAILED; unknown checks retain evidence as UNKNOWN; neither triggers model retry.

GET task/candidate projection and existing artifact content serve sealed diff/check bytes with current authorization. A later original-tree change sets applicability/compare status to CHANGED, while keeping the pinned candidate and its valid historical diff. S09 alone will add user acceptance/CAS application.

root_interface_rev3_fields_to_freeze.compatibility: Current closed rev2 DTOs and Codex-only clients cannot silently consume new Task fields or candidate tasks. Keep current workspace-read responses unchanged and candidate tasks explicitly opt-in in submit/list/get/events. Root must freeze the compatible route/selector or API-version strategy before source; do not edit the rev2 artifact in place.

candidate_spec.source_paths: Bounded canonical relative paths whose actual bytes may be copied, with explicit size/count limits.
candidate_spec.editable_paths: Subset of source_paths plus explicitly permitted new canonical paths; no globs or absolute paths.
candidate_spec.expected_baseline_hash: sha256 string or null; if present, compare to the Host-produced actual baseline manifest.
candidate_spec.check_policy_ref: Opaque Host-known immutable policy/version reference, not executable/argv/shell input.

submit_candidate_variant.stable_request_identity: Existing request_id covers the complete normalized candidate intent including roster and check policy. A conflict cannot reuse the original key.

task_candidate_projection.candidate_ref: Opaque task/run/epoch-bound reference; never raw directory path.
task_candidate_projection.status: PREPARING | IMPLEMENTING | CHECKING | READY_FOR_REVIEW | CHECK_FAILED | CANCELLED | UNKNOWN
task_candidate_projection.baseline_manifest_ref: Existing exact VersionRef to sealed actual input inventory/hash.
task_candidate_projection.candidate_manifest_ref: Existing exact VersionRef to sealed final file inventory/hash.
task_candidate_projection.diff_ref: Existing exact artifact VersionRef plus bounded text/file summary; full content through existing getArtifactContent.
task_candidate_projection.check_report_ref: Exact run-bound report reference including each declared check and raw stdout/stderr refs/hashes/exit; NOT_RUN and cancelled are never PASS.
task_candidate_projection.applicability: UNCHANGED | CHANGED | UNVERIFIED; this is an observation, not user acceptance.
task_candidate_projection.accepted: Do not expose accept/apply=true. S09 is later.

root_interface_rev3_fields_to_freeze.capabilities: candidate_write/checks/diff true only for the actual supported bounded policy; actual Windows write enforcement stays separately UNVERIFIED until Root real allow/deny evidence. resume/pause/tool approval remain false.
root_interface_rev3_fields_to_freeze.events_and_cancel: Reuse current stable outbox/cursor/reset/end semantics, decimal int64 strings and exact task_revision/run_id/epoch CAS. Add only frozen candidate phase fields; phase events never substitute for terminal proof.

proposed_backend_production_paths.purpose: Host-authorized roster, root/inventory guards, fresh candidate/baseline copies, same-byte snapshot/diff and typed candidate/check policy port implementation.
Candidate intent/seals/projection using the same existing Run/ArtifactUse; no schema migration or journal.
Frozen candidate DTO/authority/check ports and admission; ordinary readonly validation preserved.
Integrate prepare/one native turn/check/seal into existing claim, lease, cancellation, terminal event and recovery; derive task projection from sealed facts.
Inject the actual Host candidate/check port as a trusted dependency, never request/environment data.
Admit the exact candidate backend mode under the original authority gates.
Bind candidate policy/roster/profile digest to dispatch; reject read/write mode or source identity mismatch.
Supply supported candidate policy metadata and actual Host composition, without extra CLI/model probes during GET.
Private typed candidate launch scope; no JSON-created authority or changes to legacy ParseStreams.
Fixed candidate permission profile and owned cwd/marker; old readonly argv and complete Job wait preserved.
Small fixed-check Job runner using existing process helpers, plain check result rather than Codex protocol parsing. No scheduling, arbitrary commands or new controller.
Implement Root-frozen candidate variant/projection selection; keep old readonly wire shape and authorization.
Inject one Host candidate/check producer into the same Coordinator.

thin_client_followup_separate_lease.note: Existing ActivityRail can show generic state; add activity.js/rail only if the frozen phase event needs it. The current Desktop narrow bridge must explicitly allow the frozen candidate fields and existing artifact-content reads. Do not fake an old V2 session_id for diff. The existing harness-workbench test path was read back on Main; candidate-diff is a proposed new exact path.
thin_client_followup_separate_lease.security: Render patch/code as inert escaped text; no HTML/Markdown execution, link traversal, automatic file opening or apply. Full diff/check evidence is Host content, not renderer cache authority.

source_and_fresh_fixture: Dirty original bytes are baseline; original tracked/untracked/dirty bytes, index and metadata stay byte-identical after candidate execution and failed/cancelled checks.

Fresh-dir negative cases for traversal, Windows reserved/alias paths, duplicate case, reparse/junction, hardlink, source/candidate containment, extra file, copy-time drift, changed fixed tests/config and post-check candidate mutation.

Owned fake native/check processes prove exactly one native Start, original lease/events, cancellation while prepare/native/check, nonzero actual check failure and preserved complete raw output, no implicit second model turn.
Inject evidence upload/terminal-event failure; rollback projection atomically, retain UNKNOWN/fence, Recover+Scan never relaunches native/check work without positive completed facts.

Diff content hashes match the exact sealed baseline/final bytes; existing authenticated artifact download verifies refs/hash/size; inert UI diff cases include malicious markup, control text, large/binary diff policy.
Existing Codex workspace-read, CLI/UI rev2 and Mu tests remain compatible. No source-fixture test is reported as real Windows/model qualification.
root_registered_real_acceptance: Use one fresh public fixture with deliberate original dirty content, an explicit edit roster, a Root-reviewed check policy and source/toolchain/binary pins. Preserve original pre/post inventories and actual command logs.
Windows enforcement must actually permit only owned candidate writes and deny original/outside canary writes. Job cleanup alone and requested TOML do not satisfy this.

One actual Codex task changes candidate bytes and one actual declared check executes with complete output/exit. Compile-only checks are labelled compile checks, never test PASS. A deliberately failing declared test must remain failed and retain candidate/diff.

Cancel during native work and during checks; prove original dispatch is fenced, all owned child/pipe cleanup completes and restart does not resubmit. Then show the sealed candidate/diff in the default client.

check_isolation_limit: Before a policy supports arbitrary project tests, its execution boundary must be proven: project test code can write/read outside cwd, and a Windows Job only limits lifecycle. The first real acceptance can use an exact trusted public fixture/check policy; that must not be advertised as generic untrusted-test isolation. Existing Mu AppContainer constraints are not silently reused for Codex or a full Go toolchain.

persistence_and_legacy.database: Existing store only; seal versioned MANIFEST/REPORT content and existing ArtifactUse. No new table, scheduler or migration.
persistence_and_legacy.history: Keep original Task/NoProgress input semantics, UNKNOWN, original parent approval/Owner gates, all old 22/42 incomplete/formal0 and failure counters. New scope does not recover or adopt paused addons.
persistence_and_legacy.paused_addon: Old CP599 candidate-capture source is not in current Main and is not an implementation dependency. Consult its reviewed invariants only, never copy its unintegrated source or claim its fixtures qualify the new product path.
persistence_and_legacy.result_membership: Keep a single authoritative Harness result artifact that references auxiliary Host candidate/check seals; preserve original output/report semantics rather than adding model-produced final bundles.

root_normal_implementation_work: Freeze rev3 fields/compatibility and exact source lease; not a user permission request.
Implement and independently review the listed candidate/check path; it is currently missing source, not missing authorization.
real_resource_or_policy: A separately registered real Codex/Windows candidate-write profile and check boundary exercise is still required before qualified READY.
A supported check policy must bind a real available offline toolchain and reviewed command/input closure; arbitrary project tests are not automatically trusted.
User/application-level choice of source/edit roster and check policy is task data, not executable or authority input.

proposal_diagnostics.description: Read-only lookup used nonexistent runtime_artifacts.go, runtime_check_delivery_windows.go, runtime_tools_capture.go, workspaces.go and adapters/harness names. Existing actual paths were then identified. These were source discovery errors, not build/test/native runs; no old operation was replayed.
One repository-root filename listing was too broad and truncated. No receipt/secret content was opened; all later reads were exact production paths. No D write occurred.
